jobs.title: Head of Talent Planning
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


At a pivotal moment in our firm's transformation, we are reimagining how we identify, develop, and deploy our most valuable asset: our leaders. As the **Head of Talent Planning**, you will work on the firm's global succession planning architecture, talent identification strategy, and governance framework. Reporting directly to the Head of Global Talent Strategy and partnering regularly with the CHRO and the Leadership Team, you will shape the succession pipelines that safeguard the future leadership of one of the world's most globally interconnected financial institutions.

  

  

This is not a routine HR operations role. You will lead the enterprise agenda for **Succession Transparency, Talent Policy \& Controls, and Executive Bench Strength**, operating at the intersection of boardroom strategy, data\-driven talent intelligence, and agile execution.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Accountable for brokering, setting, communicating and delivering global strategy in partnership or collaboration with Head of Talent Strategy
* Accountable for building the framework for consistent, end\-to\-end global talent processes and measuring progress in partnership with Head of Talent Strategy and Talent Working Group
* Engages and consults with CHRO, Head of Talent Management \& Engagement, and other senior leaders to set key priorities in support of business priorities.
* Ensures clear, globally consistent content, communication, alignment and delivery, recognizing business/function differences/nuances
* Accountable for succession management of top senior executives across the organization
* Partners with business heads, Head of Talent Strategy and HRAs to define global programs that inform culture and drive manager and leadership accountability for talent
* In partnership with Head of Talent Strategy, curates and leverages talent analytics to identify global trends and enable leaders to effectively manage talent pipelines and inform better decision making
* Designs and delivers of board of directors’ talent trends, progress and outcomes (global talent and CEO succession)
* Deliver talent insights and succession readiness for presentations to the Board of Directors and other Senior Committees when requested
* Define and track talent management metrics: retention of high performers, internal mobility rate, leadership bench strength, and program effectiveness
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

**Qualifications:**


* 15\+ years of experience in Talent Management or HR Advisory, including 8\+ years' managerial experience
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office with an emphasis on MS Excel
* Talent Intelligence \& Strategic Storytelling: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex workforce data and predictive metrics into clear, persuasive executive narratives that drive C\-suite and Board\-level decision\-making
* Self\-motivated and detail oriented
  

  

  

**Education:**


Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred and managerial experience

jobs.title: Director, Strategy and Insights
jobs.description:
**Hiring Range:** $134,985 \- $179,980  

  

Centennial College recognizes and affirms Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Indigenous ways of knowing as central to the vibrancy and uniqueness of its learning and working academic mission. We strongly encourage applications from members of Indigenous communities and all equity\-deserving groups including Women, Racialized, Persons with Disabilities, and LGBTQ\+ communities.


We also recognize that Centennial is situated on the Treaty Lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation and pay tribute to their legacy as well as that of all First Peoples that have been and remain present here in Toronto. We recognize that First Peoples come from sovereign Nations and that part of understanding our responsibilities of residing on this territory are understanding the true history, circumstances and legacy of the Treaties signed here (such as the Toronto Purchase, Robinson\-Huron Treaty and Williams Treaties) and including pre\-contact Treaties and Agreements between sovereign Nations and that all peoples in this area are therefore Treaty people with obligations and responsibilities to all our relations.


**Position Summary**  

Centennial College is seeking a strategic, collaborative, and forward\-thinking leader to serve as our Director, Strategy and Insights.


Reporting to the Associate Vice President, Strategy, Innovation and Assurance, the Director provides enterprise leadership for institutional strategy, planning, governance, enterprise risk management, business intelligence, data analytics, and evidence\-informed decision\-making across the College. The role serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and the Board of Governors and plays a critical role in helping Centennial translate strategy into measurable outcomes.


Why Centennial?  

Centennial College is Ontario's first public college and one of Canada's most diverse post\-secondary institutions. We are committed to innovation, inclusion, student success, and community impact. This role presents a unique opportunity to help shape the future direction of the College by connecting strategy, governance, risk, data, and organizational insights into a unified enterprise approach.

  

  

**What You'll Do**  

As Director, Strategy and Insights, you will:


**Lead Institutional Strategy and Planning**


* Guide the development, activation, and continuous evolution of Centennial's institutional and divisional strategic plans.
* Facilitate annual and multi\-year planning processes that align priorities across academic, service, and operational areas.
* Lead development of the College's Business Plan, Annual Report, performance measures, and strategic progress reporting.
* Provide strategic advice and guidance to senior leaders on planning, priorities, organizational performance, and emerging opportunities.

  

  

**Drive Data, Analytics and Organizational Insights**


* Provide leadership to the Data, Analytics and Research Office (DARO).
* Advance business intelligence, data analytics, dashboards, and performance reporting capabilities.
* Support executive decision\-making through high\-quality analytics, predictive insights, environmental scanning, and organizational performance reporting.
* Strengthen organizational data governance, stewardship, quality, accountability, and responsible AI practices.

  

  

**Lead Enterprise Governance**


* Design and strengthen governance frameworks, decision\-making processes, committee structures, and accountability mechanisms.
* Lead Shared Services governance and support enterprise\-wide initiatives requiring cross\-functional coordination.
* Provide leadership for institutional AI governance and responsible use of emerging technologies.
* Support organizational effectiveness through governance, process improvement, and enterprise architecture principles.

  

  

**Advance Enterprise Risk Management**


* Lead Centennial's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.
* Facilitate risk identification, assessment, monitoring, reporting, and mitigation planning across the College.
* Support executive and Board oversight through risk reporting and strategic risk analysis.
* Embed risk\-informed decision\-making into planning, governance, and major initiatives.

  

  

**Lead High\-Performing Teams**


* Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to a multidisciplinary team of managers, analysts, researchers, planners, and risk professionals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and evidence\-informed decision\-making.
* Manage portfolio budgets, resources, priorities, and operational plans.

  

  

**Qualifications/Experience**  

The successful candidate will bring:


* A four\-year degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Education, Data Analytics, Organizational Effectiveness, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Graduate studies and/or relevant professional certifications such as CSP, GPC.D, PMI\-RMP, or equivalent are preferred
* Nine (9\) years of progressive experience in strategic planning, governance, enterprise risk management, analytics, organizational effectiveness, or related areas, including at least 5 years of leadership experience
* Demonstrated success advising senior executives and Boards on complex organizational matters.
* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives in complex public\-sector or post\-secondary environments.
* Strong expertise in performance measurement, governance frameworks, enterprise risk management, business intelligence, data analytics, or organizational strategy.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder engagement, and relationship\-building skills.
